text: Down at the pond, someone else was waking up too.
Good morning, sun! Good morning, sky! Good morning... um. Who are you?
I don't know. I just woke up.
Me too! I've been asleep at the bottom of the pond all winter.
Under the water? How did you breathe?
Through my skin! When the water's cold and I'm all slowed down, that's all I need.
It's true. Some frogs rest at the bottom of a pond all winter long, breathing through their skin, and waiting for spring.
Hey, you've got a little sprout on your head! A little sprout... Sprout! Can I call you Sprout?
And I'm Springs! Because I'm full of hops. Watch!
I don't think I'm a hopper.
I don't think I'm a frog either.
Then let's find out what you are! I know someone who knows everything about this meadow. Well... everything under it.
So off they went together. Springs went first, of course.
